ratio_filter.definition: width / height of nonzero unaugmented foreground mask bounds

calibration.method: Maximize frame pass rate minus negative false-positive rate (Youden J); ties: fewer false positives, then higher threshold.
calibration.limitation: Threshold tuned on these development images. Reported rates are in-sample; an independent held-out test is required.
